<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD packages `note-gen`, a Tauri-based Markdown note-taking application, from its official upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/codexu/note-gen`). The source is a pinned release tarball with a proper SHA256 checksum, and the build uses standard Tauri tooling (`pnpm install` + `pnpm tauri build`).

The `prepare()` function addresses two legitimate build issues: (1) creating a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to allow building esbuild, sharp, and unrs-resolver under pnpm 10/11 strict policies, and (2) vendoring `libspa-sys-0.8.0` from the local cargo registry and bumping its bindgen dependency from 0.69 to 0.72 to fix a layout compatibility issue with pipewire ≥ 1.6 headers. The vendored crate is sourced from the local cargo cache, not from a network fetch.

The `package()` function installs the binary as `note-gen-real` behind a bash wrapper script that detects the graphics session type (Wayland vs X11) and applies `WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1` when running under X11. The wrapper uses `logger` for local syslog debug logging and `exec`s the real binary with passed arguments. There is no network exfiltration, no obfuscated code, no external downloads, and no dangerous command execution. Icons, desktop file, and the symlink are standard packaging operations.
</details>
